FX-CHBLUR-015.says: Units Blurriness (After Effects), Red Blurriness 10, the rest 0: red at sigma 3, reaching 20 pixels. As FX-CHBLUR-001, only red is blurred and laid back inside the drawing's own covering, so green, blue and every covering are the drawing's exactly. The red is FX-CHBLUR-001's within a billionth: divided by its own covering's blur, the longer tail cancels.
